name: thin-plate
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 在相应板理论假设下进行力学描述的薄壁板状构件。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道相互作用建模中，用于对轨道板作力学描述，作为结构离散和动力特性模拟的基础。

complete_examples.text: In this work, the finite element modeling methods and related computer modules are presented to compile a simulation program to evaluate the slab track damage evolution accompanied by vehicle-track dynamic interaction, where the moving vehicle is modeled as a multi-rigid-body system with the primary and secondary suspensions, and the Bernoulli-Euler beam, thin-plate and solid finite element and spring-dashpots are introduced to model the track system.
The rail is modeled as Euler-Bernoulli beam, the concrete track slab and baseplate are modeled as thin-plate elements, and the filling layer is modeled as solid elements.

P033.title: A coupled model for investigating the interfacial and fatigue damage evolution of slab tracks in vehicle-track interaction
